description: React component for creating and editing channel bookmark names with emoji picker and input field.

methods.name: refocusEmojiButton
methods.description: Refocuses the emoji button for accessibility.

methods.name: toggleEmojiPicker
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the emoji picker.

methods.name: handleEmojiClick
methods.description: Handles emoji selection, updates emoji state, and refocuses button.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates display name state on input change.

methods.name: handleEmojiKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events on emoji button, stops propagation on Enter.

methods.name: handleEmojiResetKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events on clear emoji link, stops propagation on Enter/Space, clears emoji.
